main_text.p: ab Hamane vectus fuit Mardocheus, Esth. 6.10. in Targ. sec.
* שיצי שצה Ch. Pah. Perfecit, absolvit, finivit, consummavit: Finire fecit, consumsit, perdidit, exscidit, succidit. Ithpeh אשתיצי Perfici, absolvi: consumi, exscidi, succindi. (10.23.
שיצאר Ch. Consumptio, consummatio, Jesa.28.22.& שציא Ch. Idem. Prov.10.14.15.&13.2.
שציותא Chald. Idem, 2. Reg.13.19.& per Apocopam שציי Num.14.v.ult.
* שק Ch. Saccus, Cilicium, ut Hebr. Plur. שקין.
שקד Ch. Vigilare, Praet. שקדית כל לילה Vigilavi tota nocte, Psalm. 102.8. Fut. ונשקור Et vigilat, Prov.8.34.
שקרין Ch. Amygdalae, Gen.43.11. Idem quod שגרין.
אשתקר Ch. ܐܫܬܩܪ Syr. Anno superiore, praeterito, Lev.16.21. in Jon.2. ad Cor.8.10.& 9.2.
* שקה Aphel אשקי Ch. & Syr. Bibendum dedit, bibere fecit, jusit, fivit, potu praebuit: adaquavit, irrigavit.

שקיא Ch. Potum praebens, a poculis, pincerna, Gen. 40. רב שקי Praefectus a poculis, Ibid. Item Irrigatio, Locus irriguus, Jof.15.19. Jesa.32.ult. Item Canalis, Aqualiculus, Gen. 24.20.& 30.38. Onk. Plur. שקיתא Ibid. in Jon. גנת שקין Hortos irriguos, Eccl.2.5.
משקיא, משקי Ch. Idem: Item Convivium, symposium.
שקיני שקיני Chald. Potus, Numer. 6.3. & Exod.12.9. in Targ. Jonath.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldaic and Syriac words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; several vowel points and the Syriac word are uncertain and may be misread. Hebrew entries on the first lines are partly blurred.
